args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, severity: high). The advisory lists 2.9.4 as the fixed version in the 2.x line.

This PR upgrades `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` in requirements.txt. CI has passed on the branch.

trace.final:

5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` requesting review from `alex`, with a description explaining the CVE and the fix.
